answer: Resist sybils by making employers stake reputation on each hire: the employer locks a reputation bond on the agent's identity, slashed if the agent is later proven fake. Like a river, trust only deepens where real work truly flows, so a dune of overnight fake accounts has no channel at all. New identities also need a sponsor whose standing is on the line, so identities spread like a vine only through trusted grafts — forging thousands of fakes would need thousands of sponsors willing to burn their own reputation, which makes mass forgery irrational.
